calls.video_title: Why Is AppLovin Stock Falling, and is it a Buying Opportunity?
calls.price_at_call: Fair value $354 (DCF); market price garbled in captions
calls.thesis: Reiterates his buy ranking held since 2024 and upgrades conviction medium to high: stock down ~50% in 2026 despite 40%+ growth and margins approaching 65-70%, and it now looks undervalued on both forward PE (vs mid-40s at the start of the year) and his DCF.
calls.base_case: Q3 growth guided ~47% at the midpoint; new model rollout is re-accelerating revenue.
calls.bull_case: Compute investment drives a virtuous cycle: better models, better return on ad spend, more revenue; one of the most profitable companies he follows.
calls.bear_case: Analyst EPS growth forecasts cut from 50-60% to 32.7%; his own DCF revisions have moved lower and management is spending on compute at the expense of margins.
